outcome.quote: D30-RECOIL-OCCLUSION: The gun layer is ordered above the turret layer that carries the recoil/recuperator housing, and the tube is not drawn under the housing. In the recoil pose (gun +14 px) the tube front slides over the housing and a 14 px gap opens between the housing end and the breech ring, so the breech appears detached. Retained Ivanov/Gorovoy Fig. 2.1.1 (PDF page 18) shows the cradle/recoil system above the barrel, with the tube recoiling beneath it.

notes: AI review gate only; no individual human visual inspection.
